title: Broncos release S Taylor Rapp, but he will re-sign to the practice squad tomorrow

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos release S Taylor Rapp, but he will re-sign to the practice squad tomorrow
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos released veteran safety Taylor Rapp. However, this is just a procedural move to open up a 53-man roster spot, and Rapp is expected to be signed back to the practice squad tomorrow and likely elevated to the game-day roster on Sunday.
